meta.title: Fix flaky test_cluster_scan_non_covered_slots by replacing inefficient loop with mset
meta.body_summary: Replace a loop of 1000 individual set calls with a single mset bulk operation in test_scan.py to eliminate test flakiness and timeout failures.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot replaced 1000 sequential set calls with a single mset; human APPROVED without comments; very small change, merged quickly.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 3 changed lines, this is a minuscule edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, targeted test performance fix and merged without friction.

review_details.performance_claim: Replace 1000 individual set network calls with a single mset to reduce test runtime and eliminate timeout flakiness.

core_change_summary.description: In python/tests/test_scan.py, replaced a for-loop of 1000 individual glide_client_scoped.set calls with a single glide_client_scoped.mset({key: value}) to reduce network round-trips and test flakiness.
